content: I. 42780 is a chemical compound with the molecular formula C37H27N3Na2O9S3. It is primarily utilized as a histological stain. Methyl blue specifically stains collagen fibers blue in tissue sections. This compound is water-soluble and exhibits slight solubility in ethanol. It is commonly employed in staining protocols such as Mallory's connective tissue stain and Gomori's one-step trichrome stain. Additionally, it is used in differential staining techniques. Methyl blue also has applications in microbial fuel cells, where it facilitates electron transfer. It is available in mixtures with water blue under various names, including Aniline Blue WS, Aniline Blue, China Blue, or Soluble Blue. It is important to note that methyl blue should not be confused with methyl violet or methylene blue, which are distinct staining agents. Furthermore, methyl blue has a therapeutic application in the treatment of thallium poisoning, as it binds to thallium ions, aiding in their removal from the body.
